user_intent.original_question: 查询 average_rating 最高的 10 部电影，显示标题（title）和评分（average_rating）

business_rules.name: 评分可信度规则
business_rules.condition: 排名类查询应加 num_votes > 10000 过滤，确保评分可信度

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 高分电影 Top N（含贝叶斯校正）
historical_qa_pairs.sql: WITH global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(average_rating) AS avg_rating FROM titles WHERE title_type = 'movie' AND num_votes > 1000) SELECT t.primary_title, t.start_year, t.average_rating, t.num_votes, ROUND((t.num_votes * t.average_rating + 1000 * g.avg_rating) / (t.num_votes + 1000), 4) AS bayesian_rating FROM titles t CROSS JOIN global_avg g WHERE t.title_type = 'movie' AND t.num_votes > 1000 AND t.start_year >= 2000 AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bayesian_rating DESC LIMIT 20

knowledge.content: 排名类查询应加 num_votes > 10000 过滤，确保评分可信度。低投票数影片评分不可靠。
title_type = 'movie' 才是电影，titles 表包含9种作品类型。
